mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading selects the area between the chord and its circular arc. Right image: The shaded half-plane is the solution region of a strict linear inequality.
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and selects the solution half-plane of a linear inequality in the right image. The dark segment enclosed by the chord and arc in the upper-right of the circle. The gray half-plane to the right of the falling dashed boundary.
